Hope and Landon both fell unconscious after Josie's rescue and neither can be woken. Rafael, reanimated and weaponised by the Necromancer, is loose in the woods, and the Necromancer now carries the dark magic that used to be Josie's.
Baltimore is a trap: Amy Granderson's troopers hold the Nathan James, its crew, and the world's only vaccine, while Patient Zero Niels Sorenson is loose ashore somewhere in disguise.

The Landon everyone welcomed home was actually Malivore wearing his face. Malivore has now revealed himself and taken Cleo — and when the Super Squad demand their friends back, he replies there is something he wants too.

Amon is dead, the Equalist uprising broken, and Korra is a fully realised Avatar for the first time — airbending mastered, bending restored, Aang's spirit having reached her directly. She has her power back, but she has never lived as the Avatar the world expects her to be.

The Briarwoods are dead but Ripley escaped and the ritual to the Whispered One left an ominous black orb beneath Whitestone. Just as Emon celebrates Vox Machina as heroes, four unknown dragons descend on the capital.

Umbrasyl is dead, but Thordak still rules occupied Emon and broods over a clutch of unhatched eggs, with Vorugal still at his side. The green dragon Raishan has revealed herself and is now offering Vox Machina an alliance — with motives entirely her own.

Ken is dead, Landon serves as the Ferryman of Limbo, and Alaric has left to write the definitive history of the supernatural. Hope has put her necklace back on and, alongside Caroline, welcomes a new class of witches, vampires and werewolves to the Salvatore School.

The Chroma Conclave is destroyed and Percy has been resurrected, at the cost of a deeper curse on Vax and a scattered Vox Machina. In a distant temple, cultists complete a ritual that summons the Whispered One as a full-fledged evil god.

The Whispered One has ascended to full godhood, exactly as he planned — Vox Machina's own killing blow was the final step of his ritual. He has forced them to kneel before him on a broadcast seen across Exandria, and disintegrated Vax for refusing.
David has just been freed from years of possession, but Farouk has escaped inside Oliver's body — and before David can catch his breath, a floating orb appears and carries him away.

Hope has sealed Malivore by throwing herself and Clarke into the pit. The world's memory of her is erased, and Landon has resurrected alone into a school and a father figure who don't know she ever existed.

Charles's truce with both Farouks spares his son but unwinds the future David and Syd had lived through; the timeline resets and the two of them fade away, hoping the new versions of themselves will find a better life.

David has been exposed as a monster who assaulted Syd and fled with Lenny into hiding; Farouk sits arrested at the peak of his restored power, and the team he abandoned is left to hunt the man they trained.
Gates is dead and Hunter is in police custody, but the mole known only as 'The Caddy' — Cottan — is still serving, and his boss now has plenty to trade.
The mole is dead and Fairbank is going down, but Cottan's dying declaration hints at a wider network of corrupt officers, and the OCG that recruited him has never been touched.
Hunter is dead, Denton is serving life, and Dryden is disgraced — but Cottan has walked deeper into AC-12 with a dead officer taking the blame for his own crimes.
Buckells is in custody as the Fourth Man, but the senior officers who let him climb have not been touched, and Osborne is quietly closing down the anti-corruption unit that caught him.
The Amrohi mission succeeded and destroyed Cruz. She has cut Joe off, Joe is questioning the Lioness program, and Neal is quietly certain his wife kills people for a living.

Pat Brown has landed on Malibu's beach with two armed men in hazmat suits. Carol is pregnant with what everyone believes is Tandy's baby, Erica with the late Phil's, and Mike has vanished into the desert possibly carrying the virus.

Pablo now runs Los Tigres for the CIA, Chinese scientists and an MSS agent are dead in Iran, and Joe — nearly killed on the border — has come home to Neal, who told her she'll always have a home to return to.

The Lockes think they've won. Dodge is actually living inside Kinsey's new boyfriend Gabe, Eden was also possessed at the Black Door, and Ellie — Rufus's mother — was sent through it in Dodge's disguised form.

Kinsey stabs Gideon with the Alpha Key and Nina shoves him into his own portal. The Lockes throw the keys through to seal it, first using the Memory Key so they'll never forget the magic. Yet whispering can still be heard at Keyhouse.
Hilton is dead and Huntley is in prison, but Cottan's dying words insisted there is a senior officer with an 'H' surname inside the force — and Hastings knows he's still on the list.

Dodge is dead, but Eden summoned an older, worse demon named Gideon at the well and got thrown down it for her trouble. Gideon is loose in Matheson with the Anywhere Key, and Tyler — grieving Jackie — has left on a road trip refusing to remember any of it.

Sylvie has killed the TVA's architect and torn the Sacred Timeline open into an uncontrolled multiverse. Loki is stranded in a TVA that has no memory of him, where a statue of one of He Who Remains' variants now stands in place of the fake Time-Keepers.

Loki now sits alone at the End of Time, personally holding the branching multiverse together as a living tree. Sylvie and Mobius have walked away into quiet lives, and the reformed TVA hunts He Who Remains' other variants across the branches.

Sauron now holds the nine Rings for Men, Eregion has fallen, and Celebrimbor is dead. The surviving Elves have retreated to a hidden valley, Númenor has slid into open hostility toward the Faithful, and Elendil has fled west with the sword Narsil.

Alfred is dead and Edward wears the crown Uhtred fought to secure. But Cnut still commands the Danish army in the north, Brida still believes a Saxon killed Ragnar, and Uhtred's family and lands are lost.
The Biggeloe cell is broken and Hastings has kept his job, but 'H' has not been proven singular, half the bribe money is unaccounted for, and an OCG child from years back is now a serving officer.

flags.claim: an OCG child from years back is now a serving officer
flags.evidence: Ryan Pilkington joins the police academy.
flags.correction: At the end of the season Pilkington has only just joined the police academy — he is a trainee, not yet a serving officer.

results.cliff: The hatch stands open with a light burning at the bottom. Walt is somewhere at sea in the hands of strangers, Sawyer is bleeding out on a pontoon, and Rousseau's warning about the Others has just come true.

Jack has called the freighter over Charlie's dying warning that it isn't Penny's. And in a flash the show has just admitted is the future, off the island, a bearded and broken Jack tells Kate they need to go back.

The three Elven Rings have been forged with Sauron's guidance and no one but Galadriel and Elrond knows it. Sauron has fled Eregion, the Southlands are now Mordor, and Númenor has vowed to return for vengeance.

Jacob is dead, stabbed by Ben on the orders of a man wearing John Locke's face — while Locke's actual corpse sits in a crate on the beach. In 1977, Juliet has just struck the Jughead's core, and the screen has gone white.

The island survived. Its protector died to save it. Everyone who mattered — the ones who lived, the ones who died on the sub, the ones who died decades apart — finally gathered in a place they built together to find each other again.
The Robinsons are back together on Jupiter 2, but the alien engine has hurled them to an unknown star system Will recognises as 'Danger'. Smith is caged; Robot is lost in space.

The island is gone. The Oceanic Six have been living a public lie for years; the rest of the survivors have been abandoned somewhere in time. Jack has finally cracked, standing over Locke's coffin as Ben tells him everyone left has to come back — and take the body with them.

The children's Jupiter has arrived not at Alpha Centauri but at an unknown system, staring at the derelict Fortuna — the ship of Judy's biological father, missing for twenty years. Robinsons, Don, Smith and Robot are scattered across the escape.
Alpha Centauri is safe, the war with the robots is over, and the Robinsons have settled into new lives. Will and the transformed Robot have set out together to explore beyond the colony.
Victor has thanked Simon and hung up, ready to run to whichever boy he has chosen — Benji, who is fragile and pulling away, or Rahim, who has just kissed him. The audience is not told which.
Lucifer has traded his return to Hell for Chloe's life, and God has held him to it by loosing his mother's soul on Earth. Neither brother knows what body she's wearing or what she'll do first.

Victor comes out to his parents on the same night they announce their separation, with no idea how either of them will respond. Benji is newly single and waiting, Mia is heartbroken, and the family is fractured.

The Swan has imploded in a violet burst that lit up the sky. Jack, Kate, Sawyer and Hurley are prisoners of the Others. Michael and Walt are motoring away to freedom, alone, having gotten there by murder.
Lucifer has returned to Hell voluntarily to keep demons from Earth, leaving Chloe with a mutual 'I love you' and no idea when — or whether — he'll come back. Eve has left to find herself.

The series ends here. Lucifer is the therapist of Hell, Amenadiel is God, Rory has taken her place in her own time, and Chloe has lived a full life on Earth before being reunited with Lucifer for good.

Lucifer has exiled his mother to her own universe and lost the Flaming Sword with her. He wakes in the desert with the wings he burned in Season 1 back on his shoulders, and no idea who put them there.

Don's Kodak triumph is undercut by a house standing empty for Thanksgiving. Adam has hanged himself, Peggy has secretly given birth to Pete's son, and Pete now knows Don was once someone called Dick Whitman.

Sterling Cooper has been sold to PPL, Duck's coup has failed, and Don has walked back into a marriage that now includes a baby conceived on the eve of separation. Peggy has finally told Pete he fathered her child.
Chloe is standing across from Lucifer, staring at his devil face, having just watched him kill her ex-fiancé. Everything he's ever said turns out to have been literal.

SCDP has clawed itself back from Lucky Strike's exit with a pantyhose account, and Don has stunned the office by announcing he is marrying his secretary Megan instead of the woman everyone expected. Faye is out, Bert has quit, and Joan is quietly carrying Roger's child as her husband ships out.
Lucifer has proved himself worthy of the vacant throne of Heaven and the assembled angels are kneeling before him. Dan is in Hell, Michael is wingless, and Chloe is alive again.

Smith is dead, the American invasion of the Pacific States is halted, and the Nebenwelt portal stands wide open with people from countless other realities pouring into this one. Abendsen has walked through it to another life.

Zeke has walked out of a cave with the same blood marker as the 828 passengers, proving the phenomenon isn't unique to the flight. In Michaela's apartment, a fight between Zeke and Jared triggers an off-camera gunshot, and the Death Date - June 2, 2024 - now hangs over everyone.

On the Death Date, Flight 828 rose from a fissure, the passengers boarded and were judged - eleven turned to ash - and the plane returned intact to April 7, 2013. Everyone lost along the way is alive again; the returnees are stepping back into the lives they were meant to have, with Cal restored to boyhood and no memory of the years he lived.
Kilgrave is dead but IGH is not. Trish has just found that the shadow company paid for Jessica's care after her family's fatal accident, and Simpson has been quietly retrieved by Dr Kozlov.
The season and series end with Victor and Benji reunited on the Ferris wheel where the show began, and every friend paired off or moving on to a new city.

Fisk is back in prison but bought his freedom for Vanessa's silence over Nadeem's murder, and the firm is reborn as Nelson, Murdock & Page. Dex, paralyzed by Fisk, is on a surgeon's table having his spine rebuilt.

Trish has killed Jessica's newly-found mother Alisa, and Jessica has taken the blame to protect her. Trish's own body is reacting to Malus' half-finished procedure — her reflexes are quickening — and the sisters are barely speaking.

Frank has been officially cleared and his family avenged, but he tells Curtis's support group that he's scared of who he is without a war. Russo lives — disfigured, publicly blamed for everything — and Madani has recovered from a bullet to the head knowing exactly who put it there.

Jessica has publicly unmasked her sister Trish as the killer 'Hellcat' and sent her to the Raft. She almost fled the country afterwards but stayed after hearing Kilgrave's voice in her head telling her to abandon everyone.

Midge has just torn down the fourth wall on The Gordon Ford Show and been fired for it seconds after Gordon offered her a couch spot on air. Fame has arrived; every relationship she leaned on to reach it — Susie, Joel, Lenny, Gordon, Hedy — is compromised.

Cate, May, Keiko, and Tim have rejoined Monarch and are hunting Kentaro. He and Isabel have escaped to Thailand chasing her promise to reach the 2014 version of Hiroshi trapped in Axis Mundi. Shaw is already there, and has just found Rodan waiting inside a volcano.

Alex is sick with COVID and openly refusing to apologize for who she is on national television. Bradley has walked off the show to find her missing brother, moments after Cory told her he is in love with her.

Alex has resigned from TMS but she and Cory have exposed Celine's Wolf River cover-up on live television, forcing Celine out of UBN. Bradley has been freed from a Belarus prison and the network is looking for its next interim CEO.

Stage 2 is armed, Elliot has just been shot by Tyrell to keep it that way, and Angela is now Whiterose's convert. In the desert, Trenton tells Mobley she has found a way to undo the hack before both are approached by Leon.
Whiterose is dead, her machine destroyed, and the persona the viewer has known as Elliot has stepped aside to return control to the real Elliot, who wakes in a hospital with Darlene beside him.

Five/Nine has landed and the world is in chaos. Elliot has no memory of the final days of the plan, Tyrell is gone, and Whiterose is already speaking with E Corp's CEO about who is really responsible.

Five/Nine is being reversed and Elliot has vowed to take down Whiterose. Angela, told Price is her real father, is being pulled off Whiterose's side. Outside Elliot's building, Vera has returned and is standing in front of Darlene.
The League has been repelled but not caught, All Might's power is nearly spent, and Shigaraki is being coached by an unseen master with plans far bigger than one school raid.

The Randas — Cate, Kentaro, Hiroshi, and long-lost Keiko — are reunited with May and Tim at an Apex Cybernetics station on Skull Island. Shaw is stranded in Axis Mundi again, and Kong is bearing down on the station.
Stain's captured, but his 'purge fake heroes' creed is spreading fast, the League is recruiting off it, and Shigaraki is being groomed to lead them just as Class 1-A break for summer camp.

Overhaul is beaten but the League walked off with his Quirk-destroying bullets, Mirio is Quirkless, Nighteye is dead, and Izuku has started hearing past holders of One For All in his sleep just as Hawks joins the top ranks.

Alex has just killed Paul's UBA takeover by threatening to expose that he faked the hack to hide a rocket failure. Bradley has resigned on-air and is walking into an FBI interview to turn her brother in for the Jan 6 assault she once covered up.

Félix stands atop a federation he holds together by murder, betrayal and political favours. The DEA has abandoned legal channels and launched Operation Leyenda specifically to bring down everyone who touched Kiki.

Pablo's stage-managed surrender at La Catedral has collapsed into a standoff: the government is moving to take the prison by force while Murphy, Peña and a newly-assertive Cali Cartel all wait for him to run.

All Might is finished as a fighter and All For One is imprisoned in Tartarus, but Shigaraki now inherits the League with his master's blessing, Endeavor has been thrust into the #1 slot he isn't ready for, and yakuza Overhaul is knocking on the League's door.

Devi and Paxton are finally, publicly together while a devastated Ben looks on. Kamala has walked out on her arranged engagement to sing karaoke with Manish, and Nalini has quietly stepped back from Chris.

Devi has just kissed Ben in his car after finally grieving her father with her mother, only to come home and find Paxton on her doorstep leaving her a message. Both boys are choosing her at the same moment.

Devi has decided to stay at Sherman Oaks for senior year and just walked into Ben's bedroom to have sex with him using the joke pass he gave her. Paxton has graduated toward Arizona State and Fabiola has begun dating Addison.
Latrelle's bullet has torn through both Ruby and Olivia at her own quinceañera and vanished into the night, while Jamal stands alone over a hole full of RollerWorld cash nobody else knows exists.

Shigaraki's Decay has evolved to city-wide range, his body is being rebuilt to weaponise it, and the League has just absorbed the 100,000-strong MLA into the Paranormal Liberation Front — with Hawks the only hero close enough to watch it happen.

Hannah and Garrett are together and honest with each other for the first time. Allie is quietly sleeping with Dean while sleeping with other men to keep it casual — and the new Hawks recruit Hunter, who she also slept with, has walked into their lives with a grudge against Dean.

Luffy, Zoro and Nami have a map to the Grand Line and a shaky partnership, but no ship worthy of the trip, no navigator's tools for its impossible weather, and a growing list of enemies who now know their faces.

The Straw Hats are sailing for Alabasta with its exiled princess aboard, knowing that the country's civil war is being manufactured by a Warlord of the Sea who has already put a target on their backs.
The trio has cleared its name and Oliver has staged the Broadway comeback of his life. On opening night, his leading man collapses onstage in front of a full house.
The crew is escorting Princess Vivi home to stop a Warlord-backed rebellion, with Baroque Works now hunting them by name. The log pose points at Little Garden, not Alabasta.
The Tim Kono case is closed, but the trio is walked out of the Arconia in handcuffs, framed for the murder of board president Bunny Folger by an unseen enemy.

flags.claim: framed for the murder of board president Bunny Folger by an unseen enemy
flags.evidence: Oliver and Charles receive a mysterious text message telling them to leave the building.
flags.correction: The source describes an anonymous text luring Charles and Oliver to the scene, but does not state they were framed by an 'unseen enemy' — however, the framing/setup by an unknown party is a reasonable reading. The claim of being 'framed' is supported implicitly.

results.cliff: The series ends resolved rather than open. Devi leaves for Princeton with Ben as her boyfriend at nearby Columbia, Fabiola heads to Howard, Eleanor stays in LA acting with Trent, Kamala takes the Baltimore job with Manish, Paxton returns to ASU to pursue teaching, and Nalini quietly dates Andres.
Peter is departing on his first mission as a full Night Agent, now in a relationship with Rose and finally holding proof his father died before he could turn.

Luffy has a swordsman and a reluctant navigator and a stolen map to the Grand Line, but no way in and no ship built for it. Nami is riding with them for her own reasons, not because she has joined the crew.

The inmates are frolicking briefly free in a lake outside the walls. Buses of new prisoners are pulling into Litchfield, and a stranger — Kubra's assassin — has just cornered Alex alone in the greenhouse.
The Arconia is saved and the mayor is in prison. Then the trio finds their long-time rival Cinda Canning dying at the building's front gates.

Klaus, Elijah, and Hayley have publicly lost Hope to protect her — she is alive and hidden with Rebekah. Meanwhile Esther has taken over the fourth Harvest girl Cassie, a boy at her side calling her mother, and Davina has secretly brought Mikael back from the ashes.

The series closes on scattered endings. Alex is transferred to an Ohio prison and Piper moves there to be near her. Taystee, serving life, launches the Poussey Washington Fund with Judy King's help. Blanca reunites with Diablo in Honduras. Tamika is fired; Hellman replaces her as warden.

CERT officers have blown the bunker door as ten inmates — Piper, Alex, Red, Taystee, Nicky, Suzanne, Cindy, Blanca, Gloria, and Frieda — link arms inside. Piscatella lies dead in the hallway. Everyone else has been loaded onto buses to unknown prisons overnight.

Klaus and Elijah are dead by their own hands, staked with white oak to destroy the Hollow forever. Hope survives, orphaned but free of the spirit's magic, and the remaining Mikaelsons — Rebekah, Kol, Freya — walk into lives without their brothers for the first time in a thousand years.

Sarah has rescued Kira and blinded Rachel, but Mrs. S has secretly traded Helena to the military and the existence of male Castor clones — and a young second-generation clone named Charlotte — has just been revealed.
Sarah has walked away from Dyad's offer and come home to a ransacked house — Kira and Mrs. S are missing, and Alison has already signed her life away to Leekie.

Neolution has been outed as the real power behind both clone projects. Delphine has been shot at point-blank range, and Rachel is captive on an unknown island with Charlotte and her supposedly dead mother Susan Duncan.

Rachel has betrayed Susan, hijacked the cure, and put herself in front of Neolution's founder P.T. Westmorland. Sarah is bleeding on the island while Ferdinand — now defected back to Neolution — holds Kira and Mrs. S hostage.
Rogelio and Xo have finally married. Rose is jailed at last, but Luisa is scheming revenge on Rafael — and Anezka has cornered Petra alone with a gun.

Mark has beaten Angstrom nearly to death and glimpsed a future in which he loves Eve, but he cannot yet say it out loud. Light-years away, his father sits in a Viltrumite prison finally admitting he was wrong, and a fellow inmate is quietly offering him a way out.
Zombies are public knowledge, Fillmore-Graves is mediating a fragile new peace, and Ravi has just been scratched by Liv to test whether his experimental vaccine actually holds.
Blaine's brain empire is a burning ruin and both he and Major are human again, but Peyton has fled after seeing Liv feed, and Max Rager knows exactly what Liv is.
Uhtred finally sits in Bebbanburg with Stiorra and his sons, ruling Northumbria as neither Saxon nor Scot — sworn to Edward, but not part of his England. Hild is leading a young Osbert to his door.

Official brain shipments to New Seattle are dead. Major now runs Fillmore-Graves and is secretly buying smuggled brains from Blaine to keep zombies fed, while Liv, publicly outed as Renegade, keeps her humans-through-the-wall operation running.

A brand new firm — Sterling Cooper Draper Pryce — has been born in a hotel suite, staffed by defectors and no clients guaranteed. Don has lost his marriage, and Betty is already on a plane to Reno with Henry Francis.

Lane is dead, Peggy is gone to CGC, Joan is a partner at a cost she and Don both know, and Megan is now a paid actress via a favour Don couldn't help himself from doing. Don walks away from her set alone, into a bar, into a familiar question.

SC&P is a real firm with a real Chevy account, but Don has been suspended from the agency he founded and separated from his wife after telling clients the truth about the brothel. Sally has caught him mid-affair; Pete is quietly holding blackmail on Bob Benson.
Quarles is dead, Arlo is in prison confessing to protect Boyd, and Winona has walked out on Raylan. Boyd controls Harlan through Shelby's badge and Ava's brothel.

Annalise walks out of court a free woman just as Frank and Bonnie are gunned down avenging her. A flashforward decades on shows Laurel and Wes's grown son Christopher inheriting Annalise's chair at Middleton after her funeral.

Hitler is dead and Himmler now rules the Reich, publicly praising Smith for uncovering Heusmann's plot. Thomas has volunteered himself into euthanasia, and Abendsen has told Juliana that Trudy is alive somewhere.
Boyd walks free with Raylan's silent blessing, stripped of his father, brother, and faith. Ava is a widow sleeping with Raylan; Arlo is a father who tried to have him killed.

flags.claim: Ava is a widow sleeping with Raylan
flags.evidence: Bo's men occupy Bowman's house on his orders and harass Ava, who witnesses Winona leave Raylan's motel room after having sex with him.
flags.correction: Ava is a widow, but it is Winona (Raylan's ex-wife) who is sleeping with him, not Ava; Ava tried to seduce Raylan earlier but he turned her down, and their only physical contact was a kiss in E3.

results.cliff: Grace lies stabbed by Angelina, who has taken Eden. Cal has vanished after touching the tailfin, then reappeared as an adult beside his dying mother, and Captain Bill Daly - long presumed lost - has flickered into view aboard a phantom Flight 828 in the Eureka lab.

The Nebenwelt portal is operational and Juliana has just crossed into a parallel world with Smith's bullet in her body. Frank is dead, Himmler lies wounded from a Resistance sniper, and Abendsen is Smith's prisoner.

Tagomi has crossed by meditation into an alternate 1962 where the Allies won and the Cuban Missile Crisis is unfolding. Juliana has escaped Joe knowing he is SS, and a frail Hitler still rules a Reich Heydrich almost seized.

Saanvi has killed Kathryn Fitz by accident and is hiding it from Vance and everyone else. A Cuban fishing boat has just hauled Flight 828's tailfin from the ocean, meaning the plane the passengers landed in was already wreckage.

Elektra is dead saving Matt but the Hand have stolen her body for their resurrection device. Nelson & Murdock is dissolved, Karen finally knows Matt is Daredevil, and Frank Castle has embraced the Punisher mantle.
Fisk is in federal custody and his crime alliance shattered, leaving Hell's Kitchen without a kingpin. Matt now openly fights as Daredevil while Karen carries the secret that she killed Wesley.

Midge has claimed the stage as 'Mrs. Maisel' at the Gaslight, a triumph Joel witnessed from the shadows. Her career has begun; her marriage, her family life, and her livelihood are all still unresolved.

Mad Men ends. SC&P has been absorbed into McCann. Betty is dying and Sally is going home to look after Bobby and Gene. Peggy is with Stan, Joan is running her own production company, Pete has left for Wichita with Trudy, and Don — stripped of car, wife and firm — sits on a Californian hillside, smiles, and the Coke ad plays.

flags.claim: Sally is going home to look after Bobby and Gene
flags.evidence: Sally cancels a trip to Madrid to care for her siblings.
flags.correction: The source for this season refers to Sally's 'siblings' and names Bobby, but never names Gene.

results.cliff: Ford is face-down in a Californian hospital corridor mid-panic-attack, the OPR is holding the Speck tape, and in Kansas an ADT serviceman is burning his sadistic drawings of women.

Margo holds Bodhi and a growing OnlyFans empire, but her family has been remade by the fight to keep him. Shyanne's marriage is fractured by Kenny's CPS call, Jinx is clean but exiled, and Mark now has a legal foothold in Bodhi's life every other weekend.

Three months on, Frank is operating openly as the Punisher and has turned down every path back to a normal life. Russo is dead, the Schultzes are ruined, Amy is starting over in Florida with their money, and Madani has been promoted to a CIA that would very much like to point Frank somewhere useful.

flags.evidence: Castle kills Eliza when she attacks Amy, and they blackmail Anderson, who kills himself after they leave.
flags.correction: Both Schultzes are dead by the end of the season — Eliza killed by Castle, Anderson by suicide after being blackmailed — not merely ruined.
